A <REYNOLDS NUMBER>, in fluid mechanics, is a <Property> that is a criterion of whether fluid (liquid or gas) flow is absolutely steady (streamlined, or laminar) or on the average steady with small unsteady fluctuations (turbulent). It is calculated as: Re = rho.v.l/eta = v.l/nu where rho is the volumetric mass, v is <SPEED>, l is <LENGTH> , eta is dynamic viscosity and nu kinematic viscosity
A <RFID READER> is an <INSTRUMENTATION ITEM> and a <READER> that reads passive rfid tags without mechanical contact with the tag
An <RFQ IDENTIFIER> is an <IDENTIFYING STRING> that idenfies a request for quotation
A <RHENIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Re and atomic number 75. It is a transition metal

A <RHEOSTATIC ROTOR STARTER> is a <RHEOSTATIC STARTER> for an asynchronous wound-rotor motor which, during the starting period, cuts out successively one or several resistors previously provided in the rotor circuit
A <RHEOSTATIC STARTER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <STARTER> utilizing one or several resistors for obtaining, during starting, stated motor torque characteristics and for limiting the current
subclasses: RHEOSTATIC ROTOR STARTER

description: A <RHODIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Rh and atomic number 45. It is a chemically inert transition metal
A <RHODIUM ALLOY> is a <METAL ALLOY> in which Rhodium is the basis (i.e. predominant) element
A <RHOMBUS(shape)> is a <PARALLELOGRAM(shape)> that is a four-sided flat shape with straight sides where all sides have equal length. Also opposite sides are parallel and opposite angles are equal.
A <RIB> is a <Feature> that is a long, narrow protruding part or crest in an otherwise plane surface
A <RIBBON BLENDER> is a <BLENDER> and a <DYNAMIC MIXER> that has thin, ribbon-shaped metal mixers that perform the blending
<RICH GAS> is <NATURAL GAS> that is a mixture of wet and dry gas components containing heavier hydrocarbons than a lean gas (methane, ethane, propane and butanes)

The <RICHARDSON CONSTANT> is a <Property> that is the <THERMIONIC CURRENT DENSITY> for a <METAL> . This may be calculateds as J = A.T^2.exp(-PHI/(k.T)) where T is the thermodynamic <TEMPERATURE> , k is the <BOLTZMANN CONSTANT> and PHI is the work function. Defined in ISO 80000-12 (2009) 12-27
A <RIG PITCH ANGLE> is an <ANGLE> that is the measure of the fore-aft rotational movement of the rig due the combined effects of wind and waves, measured as an <ANGLE> from horizontal
A <RIG ROLL ANGLE> is an <ANGLE> that is the measure of the side-to-side rotational movement of the rig due the combined effects of wind and waves, measured as an <ANGLE> from vertical
A <RIGHT ALIGNED OBJECT> is an <InformationPresentation> whose right side is at the right margin

An object is a <RIGHT ANGLED WEDGE> if and only if: it is a <WEDGE>; it is the result of intersecting a block and a half-space defined by a plane perpendicular to one pair of faces. Orthogonal directions x, y and z can be chosen for a <RIGHT ANGLED WEDGE> such that it is only the x dimension of the right-angular wedge that varies
subclasses: CANONICALLY PARAMETERISED RIGHT ANGLED WEDGE

description: A <RIGHT HAND THREAD> is a <THREAD> that is shaped such that it moves away, when turned counter-clockwise, relative to the mating threaded component.
An object is a <RIGHT HANDED CLOTHOID> if and only if: it is a <CLOTHOID>; it spirals to the left
A <RIGHT OF WAY> is an <AREA(space)> that is an area of legal rights for construction, maintenance and operation of certain facilities
A <RIGHT-ANGLE CONNECTOR> is an <ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR> in which the axis of the cable outlet is at right-angles to the axis of the mating face
A <RIGHT-ANGLE GEARBOX> is a <CROSSED AXIS GEARBOX> that is a gear box with crossed-axis gears at right angles.

A <RIGHTING ARM CURVE ANALYSIS> is an <ANALYSIS REPORT> documenting  assumptions and method determining that a vessel meets stability requirements during construction, tow, installation and operation phase for both intact and damage conditions as they apply based on latest deadweight weight estimate.  For FPSO will cover several loading conditions
A <RightNamespace> is a <Namespace> that indicates that the <classOfPart> is the right most part of the <classOfWhole>
A <RIGID BUSBAR> is a <BUSBAR> for substations made up of metallic tubes or bars, and supported by insulator posts.

A <RIGID COUPLING> is a <MECHANICAL POWER TRANSMISSION COUPLING> that is stiff and which is used to connect machines where it is desired to maintain shafts in precise alignment, or when the rotor of one machine is used to support and position the other rotor
subclasses: FLANGED RIGID COUPLING, SPLIT RIGID COUPLING

description: A <RIGID ENGINE SUPPORT ARRANGEMENT> is a <COMBUSTION ENGINE FOUNDATION ARRANGEMENT> that has the function to give rigid support to an reciprocating combustion engine.
subclasses: RIGID SUPPORT ON ADJUSTABLE STEEL CHOCKS, RIGID SUPPORT ON EPOXY RESIN CHOCKS, RIGID SUPPORTED COMMON FRAME

description: <RIGID FOAM> is a <Compound> and a <FOAM> made from rigid Phenolic compound, <POLYISOCYANURATE>, or <POLYURETHANE>
subclasses: RIGID FOAM INSULATION

description: A <RIGID FOAM INSULATION> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <INSULATION> on the basis of <RIGID FOAM>
A <RIGID INSULATOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <ELECTRICAL INSULATOR> intended to give rigid support to an overhead line conductor and to be stressed mainly by bending and compressible loads
subclasses: LINE-POST INSULATOR, PIN INSULATOR

description: A <RIGID PIPELINE> is an <ARTEFACT> and  a <PIPELINE> that is assembled from rigid pipes
A <RIGID RISER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <RISER> that is a rigid vertical or near vertical pipe for the flow of liquid or gas between the seabed and the surface
A <RIGID SUBSEA FLOWLINE JUMPER> is a <SUBSEA FLOWLINE JUMPER> that is rigid

uniqueName: RIGID SUPPORT ON ADJUSTABLE STEEL CHOCKS
description: A <RIGID SUPPORT ON ADJUSTABLE STEEL CHOCKS> is a <RIGID ENGINE SUPPORT ARRANGEMENT> that gives support to an engine through steel chocks with adjustable height.

uniqueName: RIGID SUPPORT ON EPOXY RESIN CHOCKS
description: A <RIGID SUPPORT ON EPOXY RESIN CHOCKS> is a <RIGID ENGINE SUPPORT ARRANGEMENT> that gives rigid support to a reciprocating piston engine through chocks filleed with epoxy.
A <RIGID SUPPORTED COMMON FRAME> is a <RIGID ENGINE SUPPORT ARRANGEMENT> that gives rigid support to a reciprocating piston engine and the driven equipment that is fixed mounted on a common frame.
A <RIGIDLY COUPLED CENTRIFUGAL PUMP> is a <CENTRIFUGAL PUMP> that has a <RIGID COUPLING>
A <RIGOROUS DISTILLATION ALGORITHM> is a <DISTILLATION ALGORITHM> that is detailed and therefore an accurate simulation
A <RING> is an <ARTEFACT> that is a circular object
subclasses: BACKING RING, BASE RING, BEARING CIRCLIP RING, CENTERING RING, COLLAR, DIAPHRAGM SEAL FLUSHING RING, DRIP RING, IMPELLER COLLET, INSULATION COLLAR, LANTERN RING, LUBRICATION RING, MATING RING, NOZZLE RING, OIL CONTROL BEARING RING, OIL RETAINING RING, OIL SCRAPER RING, OIL SLINGER, PACKING RING, PISTON RIDER RING, PISTON ROD BACK-UP RING, PUMPING RING, REINFORCING RING, SEAL DRIVE, SEAL RING, SEAL SPRING HOLDER, SHEAR RING, SHROUD BAND, SLIP RING, SPACER CAN CLAMP RING, SPLIT SHEAR RING, SUPPORT RING, THRUST BASE RING, THRUST RING, VALVE ADJUSTMENT RING, WEAR RING, WIPER RING

description: <RING CLOSING> is the <Activity> of transiting from radial operation to ring operation, or to establish a ring connection
A <RING CONNECTOR> is a <PIPING COMPONENT> and a ring arranged around the circumference of one pipe end that are moved to grip with external grooves on a second end
A <RING FASTENER HEAD> is a <THREADED FASTENER HEAD> and a <SLOTTED FASTENER HEAD> that is shaped like a ring
superclasses: SLOTTED FASTENER HEAD, THREADED FASTENER HEAD

description: A <RING HEAD THREADED FASTENER> is a <THREADED FASTENER WITH HEAD> that is furnished with a ring shaped fastener head.
A <RING JOINT FLANGE> is a <PIPE FLANGE> where the flanged end is a ring joint flanged end.
subclasses: BLIND FLANGE RING JOINT, SEGMENTED FLANGE RING JOINT, SOCKET WELDING RING JOINT FLANGE, WELD NECK RING JOINT FLANGE

description: A <RING JOINT FLANGE END> is a <FLANGED PIPE END> that has a ring joint gasket contact face
A <RING JOINT GASKET> is a <PIPE FLANGE GASKET> that is intended to be mounted in the ring joint groove of a ring joint gasket contact face.
subclasses: BX RING GASKET, OVAL RING GASKET, R RING GASKET, RX RING GASKET

description: A <RING JOINT GASKET CONTACT FACE> is a <GASKET CONTACT FACE> that has a ring joint groove.
A <RING JOINT GROOVE> is a <GROOVE> that is intended for use with a ring joint gasket.
A <RING JOINT GROOVE ANGLE> is an <ANGLE>  of a wall of a groove for a ring joint gasket, measured from a vector perpendicular to the face of the raised portion
A <RING JOINT GROOVE BOTTOM RADIUS> is a <RADIUS> at the bottom of a groove for a ring joint gasket
A <RING JOINT GROOVE DEPTH> is a <DEPTH> of a groove for a ring joint gasket
A <RING JOINT GROOVE PITCH DIAMETER> is a <DIAMETER> of a pitch for a ring joint groove
A <RING JOINT GROOVE WIDTH> is a <WIDTH> of a groove for a ring joint gasket at a face of a raised portion

A <RING MAIN UNIT> is a <SWITCHGEAR AND CONTROL GEAR UNIT> that is totally sealed, gas-insulated compact switchgear unit. The primary switching devices can be either switch disconnectors or fused switch disconnectors or circuit breakers
A <RING NUT> is a <NUT> that is furnished with a ring-shaped lug to enable it to be turned by thumb and fingers

A <RING OIL LUBRICATOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <LUBRICATOR> were the lubricating function is achieved by a lose metal ring, rotating with the shaft inside the bearing housing, dipping into oil and lifting oil from the reservoir up to the area requiring lubrication
<RING OPENING> is the <Activity> of transiting from ring operation to radial operation, or to break a ring connection
<RING OPERATION> is <OPERATING> in a manner where each point of a given part of a network is fed from one or two sources along two distinct paths

uniqueName: RING OPERATION OF A PART OF A NETWORK
description: <RING OPERATION OF A PART OF A NETWORK> is <OPERATING> method where each point of a given part of a network is fed from one or two sources along two distinct paths
A <RING SUBSTATION> is a <SINGLE BUSBAR SUBSTATION> in which the busbar is formed as a closed loop with only disconnectors in series within the loop.
A <RING-TYPE COMPRESSOR VALVE> is a <COMPRESSOR VALVE> that uses plastic (peek) valve rings to seal off the valve ports in the valve seat
<RIPPING> is the <Activity> of acting by cutting, tearing, or splitting apart or open
A <RISE AND FALL PENDANT LUMINAIRE> is a <PENDANT LUMINAIRE> of which the height is adjustable by means of a suspension with pulleys, counterweights, etc.
A <RISER> is a <FLUID CONDUCTOR> and a <FLUID TRANSPORTER> that is a vertical or near vertical pipe for the upward flow of liquid or gas
subclasses: EXPORT RISER, FLEXIBLE RISER, IMPORT RISER, MARINE RISER, RIGID RISER, SUPPORT COLUMN

description: A <RISER BASE> is a <PIPELINE END TERMINAL> that forms the termination of a subsea flowline where it is connected to a riser.
subclasses: GAS LIFT RISER BASE

description: A <RISER CAP> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <FLUID REGULATOR CAP> and a <CAP> that partly covers a riser in a bubble cap tray
subclasses: BUBBLE CAP

description: A <RISER CROSSOVER> is a <COMBINATION PIPE COUPLING> that is intended for joining of well risers.
A <RISER PIPE> is a <PIPE> installed to transfer fluid upwards
A <RISER PIPE CLAMP> is a <CLAMP CONNECTOR> and a <FLAT BAR PIPE CLAMP ASSEMBLY> that is a clamp connector with extended lugs intended to support vertical pipes.
superclasses: CLAMP CONNECTOR, FLAT BAR PIPE CLAMP ASSEMBLY

description: A <RISER REACTOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <CHEMICAL REACTOR> that is used in a fluid catalytic cracking process where feedstock and hot catalyst are injected at the bottom of the process reactor and flow upward
A <RISER SPOOL> is a <DRILLING COMPONENT> that is designed to receive a riser.
A <RISER SUPPORT> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SUPPORT> connecting a riser to a structure
<RISING> is the <Activity> of increasing in quantity or number

A <RISING STEM BALL VALVE> is a <BALL VALVE> and a <SINGLE SEATED VALVE> that is designed to seal by using the valve stem to mechanically wedge the valve ball into a stationary seat effecting a bubble tight seal
A <RISING VALVE STEM> is a <ROTATING VALVE STEM> that has the threaded portion of the stem isolated from the process media by the gland packing, and the stem rises via a threaded nut in the yoke
A <RISK> is a <PROBABILITY>, expressed in <RISK LEVEL>. of something bad happening
<RISK ANALYSING> is <ANALYSING> a <RISK>
A <RISK AND OPPORTUNITY MANAGEMENT PLAN> is a <PLAN> capturing how risks and opportunities will be documented, communicated, managed, and closed.  Typically the plan is built upon a strategy

A <RISK AND OPPORTUNITY REGISTER> is a <REGISTER> that is an authoritative collection of items with a relationship to risks and/or opportunities which have a potential to impact overall project performance.  The columns of this collection are specified and controlled
A <RISK ASSESSMENT REPORT> is a <REPORT> and an <ASSESSMENT RECORD> that describes the results of an overall assessment of overall compound technical risk foreseen for the project

A <RISK LEVEL> is a <SEVERITY LEVEL>  expressing the a <PROBABILITY> of a threat of quantifiable damage, injury, liability, loss, or any other negative occurrence that is caused by external or internal vulnerabilities, and that may be avoided through preemptive action
subclasses: RISK LEVEL - EXTREME, RISK LEVEL - HIGH, RISK LEVEL - LOW, RISK LEVEL - MEDIUM, RISK LEVEL - VERY LOW, SAFETY RISK LEVEL, STRESS RISK, STRESS RISK LEVEL

description: A <RISK LEVEL - EXTREME> is a <RISK LEVEL> that is the resultant of the following PROBABILITY - SEVERITIY LEVEL combinations:  UNLIKELY vs CATASTROPHIC, POSSIBLE vs CATASTROPHIC, LIKELY vs CATASTROPHIC, CERTAIN vs SERIOUS , CERTAIN vs  CRITICAL, and CERTAIN vs CATASTROPHIC
subclasses: STRESS RISK LEVEL - EXTREME

description: A <RISK LEVEL - HIGH> is a <RISK LEVEL> that is the resultant of the following PROBABILITY - SEVERITIY LEVEL combinations:                                 RARE vs CATASTROPHIC, POSSIBLE vs CRITICAL, LIKELY vs MARGINAL, LIKELY vs SERIOUS , LIKELY vs CRITICAL, CERTAIN vs  NEGLIGIBLE, and CERTAIN vs MARGINAL
subclasses: SAFETY RISK LEVEL - HIGH, STRESS RISK LEVEL - HIGH

description: A <RISK LEVEL - LOW> is a <RISK LEVEL> that is the resultant of the following PROBABILITY - SEVERITIY LEVEL combinations:                                 RARE vs MARGINAL, RARE vs SERIOUS, UNLIKELY vs NEGLIGIBLE,  UNLIKELY vs MARGINAL, and POSSIBLE vs NEGLIGIBLE
subclasses: SAFETY RISK LEVEL - LOW, STRESS RISK LEVEL - LOW

description: A <RISK LEVEL - MEDIUM> is a <RISK LEVEL> that is the resultant of the following PROBABILITY - SEVERITIY LEVEL combinations: RARE vs CRITICAL, UNLIKELY vs SERIOUS, UNLIKELY vs CRITICAL,  POSSIBLE vs MARGINAL, POSSIBLE vs SERIOUS and LIKELY vs NEGLIGIBLE
subclasses: SAFETY RISK LEVEL - MEDIUM, STRESS RISK LEVEL - MEDIUM

description: A <RISK LEVEL - VERY LOW> is a <RISK LEVEL> that is the resultant of the combination <PROBABILITY - RARE> vs <SEVERITIY LEVEL - NEGLIGIBLE>
subclasses: SAFETY RISK LEVEL - VERY LOW, STRESS RISK LEVEL - VERY LOW

description: A <RIVER> is a <NATURAL OBJECT> that is a natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea or to a lake, etc or joining anoter

A <RIVET> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <CONNECTOR> that is a headed shank or rod for making a permanent joint between two or more pieces. It is inserted in a hole which is made through the pieces, and closed by forming a head on the projecting part of the shaft by hammering or other means
subclasses: BUTTON HEAD RIVET, CONE HEAD RIVET, COUNTER-SUNK HEAD RIVET

description: A <RIVET HEAD> is a <FASTENER HEAD> which is the part of a rivet intended to be struck with a pneumatic hammer.
subclasses: BUTTON RIVET HEAD, CONE RIVET HEAD, COUNTERSUNK RIVET HEAD

description: A <RKB HEIGHT> is a <STRAIGHT LINEAR DISTANCE> from a location along the drill string to the Kelly Bushing on the drill floor. The abbreviation RKB means Relative to Kelly Bushing

A <ROAD> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <CONNECTOR> that is a thoroughfare, route, or way on land between two places and been paved or otherwise improved to allow travel by foot or some form of conveyance, including a motor vehicle, cart, bicycle, or horse
A <ROAD IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM> is an <IDENTIFICATION SYSTEM> that defines identification of <ROAD>s
A <ROAD NUMBER> is an <IDENTIFYING STRING> that is an identification a <ROAD>
<ROAD TRANSPORT> is <TRANSPORTING> along <ROAD>s
subclasses: COMMERCIAL ROAD TRANSPORT

description: <ROCK> is a <Compound> that is one of stratified or igneous material constituents of which the earth's crust is composed, including sands, clays etc
subclasses: FAULT BLOCK, IGNEOUS ROCK, METAMORPHIC ROCK, SEDIMENTARY ROCK, STRATIFIED ROCK, VOLCANIC ROCK

description: A <ROCK AREA> is a <GROUND> mainly composed of rock
A <ROCK DRILL BIT> is a <DRILL> that is the rock cutting or pulverizing tool or head at the end of a drill string. It has a <WELLBORE REFERENCE FUNCTION> since it is at the end of a drill string.
subclasses: CORE DRILL BIT, DIAMOND DRILL BIT, DULL ROCK DRILL BIT, FISHTAIL DRILL BIT, FIXED CUTTER DRILL BIT, PERCUSSION DRILL BIT, ROLLER CONE DRILL BIT, SCREWTYPE DRILL BIT, TSD DRILL BIT

description: <ROCK DUMPING> is <DUMPING> or placing rock of a predetermined quality in a location to support or cover a pipeline
A <ROCK OBJECT> is a <NATURAL OBJECT> that is one of stratified or igneous material constituents of which the earth's crust is composed, including sands, clays etc
subclasses: GEOLOGICAL RESERVOIR, GEOLOGICAL ZONE

description: A <ROCKER ARM> is a <ROD> that is a pivoted lever. In machinery operated by pushrods or overhead camshaft, wich carry the tappets of an overhead valve system.

A <ROCKER ARM COVER> is a <PROTECTION COVER> comprising shells having an upper portion and a lower portion formed by inner and outer side walls and end walls contiguous therewith; a lid is fitted to the upper portion of the rocker arm cover to provide an enclosed cavity for housing the plurality of ignition coils if present.
A <ROCKER COVER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <COVER> that is bolted on over rocker arms in an internal combustion engine
A <ROCKET PARACHUTE FLARE> is a <PARACHUTE FLARE> that is launched using a rocket.
A <ROCKWELL HARDNESS SCALE> is a <DIMENSIONLESS SCALE> and an <INDENTATION HARDNESS SCALE CLASS>, defined for Rockwell hardness test
superclasses: DIMENSIONLESS SCALE, INDENTATION HARDNESS SCALE CLASS

description: A <ROCKWOOL> is a <MINERAL WOOL> made by blowing a jet of steam through molten rock (as limestone or siliceous rock) or through slag.
subclasses: ROCKWOOL PLATE

description: A <ROCKWOOL PLATE> is a <PLATE> made of <ROCKWOOL>
A <ROD> is a <BAR PROFILE> that is a straight slender bar of metal.
subclasses: CONNECTING ROD, PUSH ROD, RELIEF VALVE SPINDLE, ROCKER ARM, TIE ROD

description: A <ROD ANTENNA> is an <ANTENNA> where the antenna structure made from copper wire ending in isolators

A <ROD DROP SENSOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <DETECTOR> giving an indication of the vertical piston movement inside the cylinder, calculated from the measurement of piston rod movement at the pressure packing case. It is located in the distance piece to detect wear of the piston wear bands
A <ROD MILL> is a <TUMBLING MILL> consisting of a horizontal cylindrical vessel in which a given material is ground by rotation with rods typically made of steel

A <ROD PUMP> is a <RECIPROCATING PUMP> using a rod attached to an assembly of check valves and other components. By the reciprocating movement of the rod liquid will be forced through the valves. These pumps are often driven by an air balancing unit
A <ROENTGENIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Rg and atomic number 111. It is an extremely radioactive synthetic element in a yet unknown category, but probably a transition metal
A <Role> is a <RoleAndDomain> that indicates what some <Thing> has to do with an <Activity>, <Relationship>, or <MultidimensionalObject>
A <RoleAndDomain> is a <Class> that specifies the domain <Class> and the <Role> for an end of a <ClassOfRelationship> or <ClassOfMultidimensionalObject>
subclasses: ParticipatingRoleAndDomain, Role

description: A <ROLL> is an <ARTEFACT> that has a <CYLINDER(shape)> <Shape> and is typically being used to transport and/or press elongated items such as pipe

A <ROLL PRESS PIERCING MILL> is a <PIERCING MILL> where a heated bloom, normally square in section, is forced through a circular roll pass and over a fixed bullet shaped point, by a pusher mounted on a rack and pinion, followed by an elongation in a rotary piercer.
<ROLL WELDING> is <SOLID STATE WELDING> that produces coalescence of metals by heating and by applying pressure with rolls sufficient to cause deformation at the faying surfaces
<ROLLED> is an <INDIVIDUAL WITH A STATUS> that has been through a mill process, where high pressure was applied by means of rolls
subclasses: COLD ROLLED, HOT ROLLED, ROLLED ARTEFACT

description: A <ROLLED ARTEFACT> is a <WROUGHT ARTEFACT> with a <ROLLED> Status  manufatured by a rolling process
A <ROLLED SURFACE> is a <SURFACE> that is <SURFACE> finish produced by rolling, i.e. the surface of the item has been treated with a roller made of hardened steel.
A <ROLLER BEARING> is a <ROLLING ELEMENT BEARING> utilizing cylindrical, conical or spherical rollers.
subclasses: CYLINDRICAL ROLLER BEARING, CYLINDRICAL ROLLER THRUST BEARING, NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING, NEEDLE ROLLER THRUST BEARING, RADIAL ROLLER BEARING, RADIAL/THRUST ROLLER BEARING, SPHERICAL ROLLER BEARING, SPHERICAL ROLLER THRUST BEARING, TAPER ROLLER BEARING, THRUST ROLLER BEARING

description: A <ROLLER CHAIN> is a <CHAIN> in which the links consist of rollers and sideplates, the rollers being mounted on pins which connect the sideplates.
A <ROLLER CHAIN FLEXIBLE COUPLING> is a <MECHANICAL CONTACT COUPLING> which employs two sprocket-like members mounted one on each of the two shafts and connected by an annulus of roller chain.
A <ROLLER CONE DRILL BIT> is a <ROCK DRILL BIT> having one or more separately rotating cone shaped cutting tools. The bit uses a crushing motion to penetrate the rock.
subclasses: INSERT ROLLER DRILL BIT, MILLED TOOTH ROLLER DRILL BIT, ROLLER CONE REAMING BIT, STEEL TOOTH DRILL BIT

description: A <ROLLER CONE REAMING BIT> is a <ROLLER CONE DRILL BIT> and a <BOREHOLE REAMER> that is a reaming bit using roller cutters.
superclasses: BOREHOLE REAMER, ROLLER CONE DRILL BIT

description: A <ROLLER CONVEYOR> is a <SOLIDS CONVEYOR> comprising a series of closely spaced rollers set so that their crests can support articles to be conveyed. They may be power-driven, or freely revolving. Tapered rollers are used to form bends in the conveyor line

A <ROLLER MILL> is a <GRINDING MILL> that, in its simplest form, consists of two rolls of suitable material, mounted with their axes horizontal, running in opposite directions; used for crushing and mixing operations
<ROLLING> is the <Activity> of forming by pressing one or more rolls over the item
A <ROLLING CONTACT> is a <SWITCH CONTACT> in which one contact piece rolls on the other.
A <ROLLING ELEMENT BEARING> is an<ARTEFACT> and a <BEARING> that utilizes rolling balls, cylinders and other rolling elements between tracks
subclasses: BALL BEARING, DOUBLE ROW BEARING, ROLLER BEARING, SINGLE ROW BEARING, SLEWING BEARING, TRACK RUNNER BEARING

description: A <ROLLING MILL> is a <METAL PROCESSING MILL> that consistS of sets of rolls used in rolling metals into numerous intermediate and final shapes, e.g. blooms,billets, slabs, rails, bars, rods, sections, plates, sheets and strip
subclasses: CONTINUOUS ROLLING MILL, PLUG MILL

description: A <ROLL-PIN> is an <SPRING PIN> that is a circular pin with a c-shaped cross-sedtion (like a tube with a slit). It deforms elastically in the radial direction when driven. The resiliency of the pin material locks the pin in place.
An <RON> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Romanian Leu' and used in ROMANIA
A <ROOF> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <COVER> that is the outside upper covering of a house or other building or the ceiling of a room or other covered part of a house, building, etc
subclasses: CONICAL ROOF, DOME ROOF, OUTER ROOF, PURLIN ROOF, RAFTERED ROOF, TANK ROOF

description: A <ROOF CORNER> is a <Feature> that is an area of a tank where the roof meets the top shell course
A <ROOF COVER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <COVER> intended to cover an outer roof
subclasses: CLAY ROOF TILE, ROOF SHINGLE

description: <ROOF COVERING> is the <Activity> of covering a roof with material that gives a particular <PROTECTING>
A <ROOF SHINGLE> is a <ROOF COVER> consisting of individual overlapping elements.
subclasses: ASBESTOS-CEMENT ROOF SHINGLE, ASPHALT SHINGLE, SLATE SHINGLE, TILE ROOF SHINGLE, WOOD SHINGLE

description: A <ROOF TRUSS> is a <TRUSS> to support a <ROOF>.
subclasses: WOOD ROOF TRUSS

description: A <ROOM> is a <COMPARTMENT> enclosed by walls or partitions
subclasses: INNER ROOM, OUTER ROOM, STORAGE ROOM

description: A <ROOT-MEAN-SQUARE VELOCITY> is a <Property> that is a measure of the speed of particles in a gas, defined as the square root of the average velocity-squared of the molecules in a gas. It is calculated as: v.eff = sqr( mean(v2))
A <ROPE> is a <MECHANICAL CABLE> that is a large stout cord of strands of non-metal fibers twisted or braided together
subclasses: KNOTTED ROPE, WIRE ROPE

description: A <ROPE GUARD> is a <PROTECTION COVER> that has a conical shape intended to cover the annulus opening between a propeller shaft and a propeller casing cover, e.g. a stern tube weldment.
A <ROTARY ACTUATOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <ACTUATOR> causing a rotary motion
subclasses: ROTARY ELECTRIC ACTUATOR, ROTARY ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC ACTUATOR, ROTARY HYDRAULIC ACTUATOR, ROTARY MANUAL ACTUATOR, ROTARY PNEUMATIC ACTUATOR

description: A <ROTARY AIR MOTOR> is an <AIR MOTOR> intended to use a rotor or turbine wheel to convert pressure energy into rotational energy
A <ROTARY BELT FILTER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <FILTER> that consist of a rotating belt

A <ROTARY BELT PUMP> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <PUMP> with a rotary belt mounted inside the pumping house. The belt is fixed between the suction and discharge sides, while rotators turn inside the belt, effectively sealing the inflow and outflow conduits in turn. The constant sealing between suction and discharge sides eliminates backflow problems, and the small number of moving parts makes operation and maintenance easy
A <ROTARY COMPRESSOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <POSITIVE DISPLACEMENT COMPRESSOR> in which compression displacement is effected by the positive action of rotating elements
subclasses: LIQUID RING COMPRESSOR, SCREW COMPRESSOR, STRAIGHT-LOBE COMPRESSOR, VANE COMPRESSOR

description: A <ROTARY CONTROL SWITCH> is a <HUMAN-OPERATED SWITCH> having an actuator intended to be operated by rotation.
A <ROTARY CONTROL VALVE> is an <INSTRUMENTATION ITEM> and a <CONTROL VALVE> and a <ROTARY VALVE>
superclasses: CONTROL VALVE, INSTRUMENTATION ITEM, ROTARY VALVE

description: A <ROTARY CONVERTER> is an <ELECTRIC MOTOR> that is adapted for use with either alternating or direct current and capable of converting one to the other

A <ROTARY COOLER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <COOLER> and a <FLUID CONTAINER> that princippally consist of an inclined rotating cylinder that is enclosed in a cooling jacket and used for cooling down fine powder or granular materials
A <ROTARY DISC VALVE> is a <PARALLEL SLIDE VALVE> and a <DISC VALVE> that has an offset shaft which slides a disc across the valve seat to open or close
A <ROTARY DRUM FILTER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <FILTER> that consists of a perforated drum covered by a filter sheet
subclasses: DEWAXING FILTER

description: A <ROTARY ELECTRIC ACTUATOR> is a <ROTARY ACTUATOR> and an <ELECTRIC ACTUATOR>
A <ROTARY ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC ACTUATOR> is a <ROTARY ACTUATOR> and an <ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC ACTUATOR>

A <ROTARY EXPANDER MILL> is a <METAL PROCESSING MILL> used in manufacturing large diameter pipe in order to enlarge the diameter. A reheated hollow is cross rolled between two rotating skew discs, over a conical plug that is placed on the longitudinal centreline of the pipe and supported by a plug bar from the delivery side
A <ROTARY FILTER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <FILTER> that rotates during filtering
A <ROTARY GATE VALVE> is a <GATE VALVE> that is manually operated by a lever
A <ROTARY HEARTH FURNACE> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <FURNACE> designed for continuous operation that is commonly used to heat metal for heat treating and forging operations
A <ROTARY HYDRAULIC ACTUATOR> is a <ROTARY ACTUATOR> and a <HYDRAULIC ACTUATOR>
A <ROTARY KILN> is a <KILN> that has a rotating cylindrical chamber which processing solids by burning, firing or drying.
types: ClassOfInanimatePhysicalObject, HEATERS, COOLERS AND HEAT TRANSFER

description: A <ROTARY MANUAL ACTUATOR> is a <ROTARY ACTUATOR> and an <MANUAL ACTUATOR>
<ROTARY PIERCING> is the <Activity> of piercing according to the principle of helical rolling
A <ROTARY PNEUMATIC ACTUATOR> is a <ROTARY ACTUATOR> and a <PNEUMATIC ACTUATOR>

A <ROTARY PUMP> is a <POSITIVE DISPLACEMENT PUMP> that consists of a chamber containing gears, cams, screws, vanes, plungers or similar elements actuated by relative rotation of the drive shaft or casing and which has no separate inlet and outlet valves.
subclasses: BUCKET PUMP, CIRCUMFERENTIAL PISTON PUMP, DISC ROTOR PUMP, FLEXIBLE MEMBER ROTARY PUMP, GEAR PUMP, HELICAL ROTOR PUMP, LOBE PUMP, MAGNETIC DRIVE ROTARY PUMP, SCREW PUMP, SIDE CHANNEL PUMP, VANE PUMP, WHEEL AND BUCKET PUMP

description: A <ROTARY STAR VALVE> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <VALVE> that has vanes intended to control streams of solids. It is usually motor driven
A <ROTARY STAR VALVE BODY> is a <VALVE BODY> of a rotary star valve
A <ROTARY STAR VALVE CLOSURE MEMBER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <VALVE CLOSURE MEMBER> that is intended for a rotary star valve
A <ROTARY TABLE DRILLING SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <WELL DRILLING SYSTEM> in which the torque is transferred to the drill string using rotary table and kelly
A <ROTARY VALVE> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <VALVE> that is a valve where the closure member has a rotating action. The axis of rotation is usually normal to the flow
subclasses: BALL VALVE, BUTTERFLY VALVE, PLUG VALVE, QUARTER TURN VALVE, ROTARY CONTROL VALVE

description: A <ROTATED WELL CASING ASSEMBLY> is a <WELL CASING ASSEMBLY> that is subjected to <WELL COMPLETION ASSEMBLY ROTATION> during the <WELLBORE CEMENTING>.
<ROTATING> is the <Activity> of turning about an axis or a center

A <ROTATING ARM CENTRALIZER> is an <ARM CENTRALIZER> and a <ROTATING CENTRALIZER> that has an arm extending outward at an angle from the pipe to that it is fixed. The <CENTRALIZER> is fixed to the pipe such that it can rotate.
A <ROTATING BOW CENTRALIZER> is a <BOW CENTRALIZER> and a <ROTATING CENTRALIZER> that has a bow shape creating a spring effect The <CENTRALIZER> can rotate in relation to the pipe.
A <ROTATING CENTRALIZER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <CENTRALIZER> that can be made to rotatin relation to the pipe
subclasses: ROTATING ARM CENTRALIZER, ROTATING BOW CENTRALIZER, ROTATING ONE-PIECE CENTRALIZER

description: A <ROTATING DISC CHOKE VALVE> is an <ADJUSTABLE CHOKE VALVE> having an orifice configuration using rotating discs

A <ROTATING DISC CONTACTOR> is a <PROCESS CONTACTOR> that is a vertical vessel equipped with a driven shaft with horizontal rotating discs and welded-in stator rings and intended for contact between liquids

<ROTATING ELECTRICAL MACHINE DUTY> is <OPERATING> is activiity which is the type of load(s) to which an electrical rotating machine is subjected, including, if applicable, starting, electrical breaking, no-load and rest and de-energized periods, and including their duration and sequence in time
subclasses: SHORT-TIME DUTY

description: <ROTATING EQUIPMENT> is a <SUBJECT AREA> of which the members are classes of rotating equipment or components thereof.
<ROTATING EQUIPMENT ENGINEERING> is <ENGINEERING>of <ROTATING EQUIPMENT SYSTEM>s
A <ROTATING EQUIPMENT ENGINEERING DISCIPLINE> is a <DISCIPLINE> that is capable of <ROTATING EQUIPMENT ENGINEERING>
subclasses: ROTATING EQUIPMENT ENGINEERING TEAM

description: A <ROTATING EQUIPMENT ENGINEERING TEAM> is a <TEAM> in a <ROTATING EQUIPMENT ENGINEERING DISCIPLINE>
A <ROTATING EQUIPMENT SYSTEM> is a <SYSTEM> using rotating equipment as main equipment
subclasses: COMPRESSOR SYSTEM, EXPANDER SYSTEM, TRANSMISSION SYSTEM, TURBINE SYSTEM

description: A <ROTATING FACE> is a <SEAL FACE> that rotates with a shaft.
A <ROTATING FREQUENCY CONVERTER> is an <ELECTRIC ROTATING MACHINE> that converts electrical energy from one frequency to another
subclasses: COMMUTATOR TYPE FREQUENCY CONVERTER, INDUCTOR FREQUENCY CONVERTER

description: A <ROTATING GROWTH AGGLOMERATOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <AGGLOMERATOR> which uses a <PELLETIZER DISC> to produce <PELLET>s
subclasses: PELLETIZER

description: A <ROTATING LABYRINTH SEAL> is a <LABYRINTH SEAL> that has teeth on a <ROTOR>

A <ROTATING ONE-PIECE CENTRALIZER> is an <ONE-PIECE CENTRALIZER> and a <ROTATING CENTRALIZER> that is essentially manufactured in one piece, ie. cast. The <CENTRALIZER> is made to rotate in relation to the pipe.
A <ROTATING PHASE CONVERTER> is an <ELECTRIC ROTATING MACHINE> and a <PHASE CONVERTER> that transfers electrical energy with change in the number of phases
A <ROTATING PISTON ENGINE> is a <PISTON ENGINE> which employs a rotating piston working inside a chamber. The piston being caused to rotate by the periodic pressure of the working fluid.
subclasses: WANKEL ENGINE

description: A <ROTATING PRESSURE AGGLOMERATOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <AGGLOMERATOR> which uses <BRIQUETTING ROLLER>s to produce pressure and to form material
subclasses: BRIQUETTING ROLLER

description: A <ROTATING SEAT GAS SEAL> is a <GAS LUBRICATED MECHANICAL SEAL> that is dry running and contains a rotating mating ring (called a seat ring). Typically used in media that contain solids or having tendency of scaling.
A <ROTATING VALVE STEM> is a <VALVE STEM>that rotates when the valve is operated
subclasses: NON-RISING VALVE STEM, RISING VALVE STEM

description: A <ROTATION ARROW> is a <Feature> that is engraved on or attached to a casing part of rotating equipment machinery to indicate the direction of rotation
<ROTATION TESTING> is <ELECTRICAL ROTATING MACHINE TESTING> to determine that the rotor rotates in the specified direction and that the terminal marking is correct
A <ROTATIONAL FREQUENCY> is a <FREQUENCY> that is the rate of rotation, or the number of rotations in some unit of time, expressed by n = dN/dt, where N is rotation and t is time
A <ROTATIONAL INERTIA> is a <Property> of a body, propotional to its mass, which opposes a change in rotational motion of the body
subclasses: ROTATIONAL INERTIA AT RATED SPEED

description: A <ROTATIONAL INERTIA AT RATED SPEED> is a <ROTATIONAL INERTIA> occurring at <RATED SPEED AT 1/1 LOAD>
A <ROTATIONAL SPEED> is a <SPEED> of an object rotating around an axis expressed in the number of turns of the object divided by time
subclasses: SYNCHRONOUS SPEED, TORSIONAL CRITICAL SPEED

description: A <ROTATIONAL SPEED MEASURING ELEMENT> is a <MEASURING ELEMENT> for the measurement of <ROTATIONAL SPEED>
A <ROTATIONAL SPEED MEASURING INSTRUMENT> is a <MEASURING INSTRUMENT> for the measurement of <ROTATIONAL SPEED>, that handles the measurement result from a <ROTATIONAL SPEED MEASURING ELEMENT>
subclasses: ROTATIONAL SPEED SWITCH, ROTATIONAL SPEED TRANSMITTER, SPEED CONTROLLER, TACHOMETER

description: A <ROTATIONAL SPEED RANGE LOWER LIMIT> is an <IndirectProperty> that refers to the <ROTATIONAL SPEED> that is the lower limit of a <ROTATIONAL SPEED RANGE>
A <ROTATIONAL SPEED RANGE UPPER LIMIT> is an <IndirectProperty> that refers to the <ROTATIONAL SPEED> that is the upper limit of a <ROTATIONAL SPEED RANGE>
A <ROTATIONAL SPEED SCALE CLASS> is a <DOMAIN SCALE CLASS> for <ROTATIONAL SPEED>
A <ROTATIONAL SPEED SWITCH> is a <PROCESS SWITCH> and a <ROTATIONAL SPEED MEASURING INSTRUMENT>
superclasses: PROCESS SWITCH, ROTATIONAL SPEED MEASURING INSTRUMENT

description: A <ROTATIONAL SPEED TRANSMITTER>is a <PROCESS VARIABLE TRANSMITTER> and a <ROTATIONAL SPEED MEASURING INSTRUMENT>
superclasses: PROCESS VARIABLE TRANSMITTER, ROTATIONAL SPEED MEASURING INSTRUMENT

description: A <ROTATIONAL TRIP SPEED> is an <IndirectProperty> that refers to a <ROTATIONAL SPEED> limit that automatic shut down the device
A <ROTOR> is a <MACHINE COMPONENT> that is the rotating portion of a machine
subclasses: CAGE ROTOR, CENTRIFUGAL COMPRESSOR ROTOR, COOLING TOWER ROTOR, ELECTRICAL ROTOR, FEMALE ROTOR, INTERNAL ROTOR, LOBE TYPE ROTOR, MALE ROTOR, PUMP ROTOR, SLIDING VANE

description: A <ROTOR ASSEMBLY WEIGHT> is a <WEIGHT> of the rotating assembly in a rotating equipment. The assembly is often a compsition of shaft, bearings, coupling half and impeller
A <ROTOR BLADE> is a <TURBINE BLADE> as part of a rotor blade arrangement provided in a serie of rows opposing a plurality of stator vanes in rotating machinery
subclasses: REVERSIBLE ROTOR BLADE

description: A <ROTOR CONTACT> is a <SWITCH CONTACT> that is the conductive segment of a rotary switch carried by the rotor and shaped to engage with the contacts on the stator as required.
A <ROTOR WINDING> is a <WINDING> on the rotor of a machine.
A <ROTORCRAFT> is an <AERODYNE> that derives its lift from a rotor, or rotors.
subclasses: HELICOPTER

description: A <ROUND BAR PROFILE> is a <BAR PROFILE> that is a solid bar having circular cross-section.
A <ROUND BATTERY CELL> is an <ELECTRIC BATTERY CELL> with a cylindrical shape, in which the overall height is equal to or greater than the diameter
A <ROUND EDGE PARALLEL FLANGE PROFILE> is a <PARALLEL FLANGE PROFILE> with parallel flanges and round edges
A <ROUND FASTENER HEAD> is a <THREADED FASTENER HEAD> that is shaped like a dome or cap.
subclasses: FREARSON ROUND FASTENER HEAD, PHILLIPS ROUND FASTENER HEAD, POZIDRIV ROUND FASTENER HEAD, SLOTTED ROUND FASTENER HEAD

description: A <ROUND HEAD PIPE PLUG> is a <THREADED PIPE PLUG> that has a round head.
A <ROUND HEAD THREADED FASTENER> is a <THREADED FASTENER WITH HEAD> that is furnished with a round head.
subclasses: CARRIAGE BOLT, FLUTED ROUND HEAD THREADED FASTENER, FREARSON ROUND HEAD THREADED FASTENER, HEX SOCKET ROUND HEAD THREADED FASTENER, PHILLIPS ROUND HEAD THREADED FASTENER, POZIDRIV ROUND HEAD THREADED FASTENER, SLOTTED ROUND HEAD THREADED FASTENER

description: A <ROUND INGOT> is an <INGOT> that has a circular cross section.
A <ROUND NIPPLE> is a <THREADED NIPPLE> that has a round shaped center piece.
A <ROUND NUT> is a <NUT> and a cylindrical shape
A <ROUND NUT UNION> is a <PIPE UNION> that has a round nut (sometimes with serrations) to facilitate tightening and untightening by hand (or using light grippers).
A <ROUND PIPE UNION NUT> is a <PIPE UNION NUT> that has a cylindrical shape.
A <ROUND PORT PLUG VALVE BODY> is a <PLUG VALVE BODY> with round portdesign.
A <ROUND PORT VALVE BODY> is a <VALVE BODY> of a round port valve
A <ROUND SIGHT GLASS> is an <INSTRUMENTATION ITEM> and a <SIGHT GLASS> with a round shape
A <ROUND THREAD> is a <THREAD> that has a symmetrical round shape.

A <ROUTE SELECTION STUDY> is a <STUDY REPORT> describing priorities and criteria, practical restrictions, and options considered for route selection.  Includes route layout drawing and/or platform approach where applicable

A <ROUTER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <ROUTER(function)> that forwards data packets toward their destinations through a process known as routing. Routing occurs at layer 3 (Network layer) of the OSI seven-layer model
A <ROUTER(function)> is a <FunctionalObject> that is capable of <ROUTING>
subclasses: CABLE ROUTING SYSTEM, ROUTER

description: <ROUTINE TESTING> is <ELECTRICAL ROTATING MACHINE TESTING> to which each individual machine is subjected during or after manufacture to ascertain whether it complies with certain criteria
<ROUTING> is the <Activity> of planning a path through a network
A <ROUTING DRAWING> is a <DRAWING> that shows alignment of cables and pipelines between facilities
<ROV INSPECTING> is <INSPECTING> performed using a <ROV>
subclasses: PIPELINE ROV INSPECTING

description: A <ROV OPERATED BALL VALVE> is a <ROV OPERATED SUBSEA VALVE> that is <A BALL VALVE>
A <ROV OPERATED CLAMP CONNECTOR> is a <CLAMP CONNECTOR> that is operated using an <ROV>.
A <ROV OPERATED SUBSEA VALVE> is an <OPERATED VALVE> having means enabling the operation of the valve using a remote operated torque tool
subclasses: ROV OPERATED BALL VALVE

description: An <RSD> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Serbian Dinar' and used in SERBIA

<RTF> is a <ClassOfInformationRepresentation> that is the Rich Text Format, a document file format with published specification developed by Microsoft Corporation from 1987 until 2008 for cross-platform document interchange with Microsoft products
An <RUB> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Russian Ruble' and used in THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION

A <RUBBER> is an <ELASTOMER> that is a type of elastic substance consisting of caoutchouc, a polymerization of product of isoprene, of resinlike substances, nitrogenous substances, inonganic matter and carbhydrates
subclasses: EPDM, HYPALON, NEOPRENE, SYNTHETIC RUBBER, VITON

description: A <RUBBER BELLOW MECHANICAL SEAL> is a <BELLOW MECHANICAL SEAL> utilising flexible rubber bellows to act both as pusher spring and to provide secondary sealing.
A <RUBBER BELLOW SEAL> is a <BELLOW SEAL> that contains flexible rubber bellows to act both as pusher spring and to provide secondary sealing.
A <RUBBER LINED BUTTERFLY VALVE> is a <LINED BUTTERFLY VALVE> that has the rotational axis of the disc concentric with the shaft axis, and where the rubber lining of the body forms the valve seat
A <RUBBER LINED PUMP> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <PUMP> that is provided with a rubber lining
A <RUBBER PLUG> is a <PLUG> that is made of <SYNTHETIC RUBBER>
A <RUBBER SEATED WEDGE GATE VALVE> is a <WEDGE GATE VALVE> that has a rubber coated wedge closure that seals against the valve port
A <RUBBER TORSIONAL VIBRATION DAMPER> is a <TORSIONAL VIBRATION DAMPER> where the turning mass is connected to the driver plate by vulcanized rubber
<RUBBING> is the <Activity> of moving along the surface of a body with pressure
A <RUBIDIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Rb and atomic number 37. It is a metallic element of the alkali metal group

The <Ruby> language is a <PROGRAMMING LANGUAGE> that is a dynamic, object-oriented scripting language for developing websites and mobile apps, Ruby was designed to be simple and easy to write. It is considered a fairly user-friendly language for beginners

An <RULE> is an <InformationObject> and a <REGULATION> that is a statement that establishes a principle or standard, and serves as a norm for guiding or mandating action. Rules are commonly published as recommended practices that allow some discretion with their interpretation and use
subclasses: DESIGN RULE

description: An <RULES AND SEQUENCES> is an <InformationObject> and a <REGULATION> that is an outline statement of the rules and sequences for commissioning
A <RUN UP TIME> is a <DURATION> of the time required for a motor to reach a certain level of operation
A <RUNG> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <ACCESS ENABLER> that is intended to be a grip or step to provide access
subclasses: GRAB RUNG

description: <RUNNING> is the <Activity> of acting by allowing a process to take place during a certain period of time
<RUNNING AWAY> is the <Activity> of running out of control
A <RUNNING TOOL> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <TOOL> that can be used to install or remove machines or equipment
subclasses: WELLHEAD HOUSING RUNNING TOOL

description: A <RUN-OF-RIVER POWER STATION> is a <HYDROELECTRIC POWER STATION> that uses the river flow as it occurs, the filling period of its own reservoir by the cumulative water flows being practically negligible.

A <RUNOUT FLOW> is a <FLOW RATE> that is the maximum flowrate that can be developed by a pump. The runout conditions correspond to a very small pump head, while the flow rate is maximal. The performance curve (published by pump manufacturer) is typically cut off at some point beyond the pump's allowable operating range (AOR)
An <RUPTURE> is a <Feature> that indicates that something has broken apart or is bursted
A <RUPTURE DISC> is an <INSTRUMENT COMPONENT> and an <OVERPRESSURE PROTECTOR> that is designed to burst at a certain excess pressure. It is a part of <RUPTURE DISC ASSEMBLY>
subclasses: DOMED RUPTURE DISC, FLAT RUPTURE DISC, FRAGMENTING RUPTURING DISC, LINED RUPTURE DISC, REVERSE BUCKLING RUPTURE DISC, SLOTTED LINED RUPTURE DISC

description: An <RUPTURE DISC ASSEMBLY> is an <INSTRUMENTATION ITEM> and a <OVERPRESSURE PROTECTOR> and that is an assembly of a <RUPTURE DISC> and an <RUPTURE DISC HOLDER>
A <RUPTURE DISC GASKET> is a <GASKET> that is intended to seal between the holders and the rupture disc in a rupture disc assembly
An <RUPTURE DISC HANDLE> is a <HANDLE> that is a rectangular plate forming part of an rupture disc.
A <RUPTURE DISC HOLDER> is an <INSTRUMENT COMPONENT> that is made to hold a rupture disc in place, consisting of an inlet holder ring and an outlet holder ring
subclasses: BOLTED RUPTURE DISC HOLDER, INSERT TYPE RUPTURE DISC HOLDER, THREADED RUPTURE DISC HOLDER, UNION RUPTURE DISC HOLDER

description: A <RUPTURE DISC HOLDER RING> is an <INSTRUMENT COMPONENT> that is a ring shaped plane ring with a seat for the rupture disc to ensure a metal-to-metal leak-tight seal between the rupture disc and the holder
A <RUPTURE DISC PORT> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <FLUID PORT> that enables a <RUPTURE DISC> to be attached

A <RUPTURE PIN RELIEF VALVE> is a <RELIEF VALVE> consisting of a piston and seat, restrained from movement by a slender round pin known as the buckling pin. The piston and seat have a bubble-tight seal while under pressure. The pin will buckle at set point from an axial force applied by the system pressure acting on the piston
<RUPTURING> is the <Activity> of tearing apart by force
An <RURAL GROUND> is a <GROUND> that is typical for a rural environment

The <RUSSIAN LANGUAGE> is a <NATURAL LANGUAGE> that is an East Slavic language and an official language in Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan; it is the largest native language in Europe, with 144 million native speakers in Russia, Ukraine and Belarus. Russian is the eighth most spoken language in the world by number of native speakers and the seventh by total number of speakers; it is one of the six official languages of the United Nations
<RUSTY> is an <INDIVIDUAL WITH A STATUS> that is a metal object  of being or having been affected by oxidation
An <RUTHENIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Ru and atomic number 44. It is a transition metal belonging to the platinum group
An <RUTHERFORDIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Rf and atomic number 104. It is A <SYNTHETIC ELEMENT> and radioactive and a transition metal
An <RWF> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Rwanda Franc' and used in RWANDA
An <RX RING GASKET> is a <RING JOINT GASKET> that has a special asymmetric octagonal cross section with holes out of centre of the cross section.

The <RYDBERG CONSTANT> is a <Property> that is a Physical Constant  that represents the limiting <VALUE>  of the highest <WAVENUMBER>   of any <PHOTON> that can be emitted from the <HYDROGEN ATOM> . Defined in ISO 80000-10 (2009) 10-8

A <SACRIFICIAL ANODE> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <ANODE>  made of highly active metals that are used to prevent a less active material surface from corroding; they are created from a metal alloy with a more negative electrochemical potential than the other metal it will be used to protect

A <SACRIFICIAL ANODE CATHODIC PROTECTION SYSTEM> is a <CATHODIC PROTECTION SYSTEM> using a sacrifical anode offering material and giving protection to carbon and low-alloy steel equipment or structures. The anode materal is a nonferrous metal standing lower in the potential chain of materials
A <SACRIFICIAL ANODE SPECIFICATION> is an <ANODE SPECIFICATION> covering sacrificial anodes
A <SACRIFICIAL ANODE SPECIFICATION DEFINITION> is an <ANODE SPECIFICATION DEFINITION> that defines the rules for the contents of a specification covering sacrificial anodes
A <SADDLE BLOCK> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SUPPORT> that is u-shaped as a saddle and used for holding down and/or stabilising an equipment or item
subclasses: PIGGY BACK SADDLE BLOCK, STABILISATION SADDLE BLOCK

description: A <SADDLE DOUBLING PLATE> is a <PLATE> intended to reinforce an area of a vessel where a saddle is mounted. The saddle is typically welded to the plate
A <SADDLE SUPPORT> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SUPPORT> that is an assembly of plates and profiles with a saddleshaped plate at the top intended to support an horizontal vessel or tank
subclasses: HORIZONTAL CYLINDRICAL ATMOSPHERIC TANK SADDLE PLATE

description: A <SAFE> is an <INDIVIDUAL WITH A STATUS> that is not likely to cause, or lead to, harm or injury; not involving danger or risk
A <SAFE LOCATION> is an <AREA(space)> that is regared to be safe
A <SAFE OPERATION STUDY> is an <STUDY REPORT> that provides the findings of an assessment of the safe operability of an electrical system
A <SAFE WORKING LOAD> is an <IndirectProperty> that refers to a <FORCE> which is the upper limit for which a lifting equipment is certified
A <SAFEGUARD CONTROLLER> is an <INSTRUMENTATION ITEM> and a <CONTROLLER> which has the capability to drive the output to High or Low upon an unwanted state of a <PLANT> or a component thereof
<SAFEGUARDING> is the <Activity> of protecting against failure, breakage, or accident

A <SAFEGUARDING PHILOSOPHY> is a <PHILOSOPHY REPORT> outlining the premise and intent for decisions that are to be followed regarding safety instrumented systems (SIS) and flare and relief systems for process integrity of a facility.  Protecting against temperature and pressure extremes, hydrates, fire, explosion, etc.

A <SAFETY BOOT> is a <PROTECTIVE BOOT> that is a durable boot or shoe that has a protective reinforcement in the toe which protects the foot from falling objects or compression, usually combined with a mid sole plate to protect against punctures from below.
subclasses: FIREMANS BOOT

description: A <SAFETY CLEARANCE> is a <CLEARANCE> that is the minimum safe <DISTANCE> to be observed between normally exposed live parts and any person
A <SAFETY COMPLIANCE REPORT> is a <REPORT> documenting analyses and evaluations of a plant with respect to safety considerations
subclasses: PLANT SAFETY MANAGEMENT REPORT

description: A <SAFETY CRITICAL ITEM> is an <InanimatePhysicalObject> that is a  part, assembly, installation, or production system that, if missing or not conforming to the design data, quality requirements, or overhaul and maintenance documentation, would result in an unsafe condition per the established risk acceptance criteria.
A <SAFETY CRITICAL ITEM GROUP> is an <InanimatePhysicalObject> that is a grouping of instances of <SAFETY CRITICAL ITEM>s

A <SAFETY DECLARATION> is a <DECLARATION> that is  issued by an  asset owner to Regulatory Authority, demonstrating compliance with Regulatory Authority safety requirements. It documents the nature and scale of hazards of an industrial facility, lays out measures developed to ensure its industrial safety and readiness for emergency response in man-induced emergency situations
A <SAFETY DEVICE> is a <FunctionalObject> with the purpose of <MAINTAINING> a safe situation
subclasses: MAN OVERBOARD EQUIPMENT STATION, PIPING SAFETY DEVICE

description: A <SAFETY DISPLAY PLAN> is a <PLAN> that indicates the location of safety signs and other relevant safety information
<SAFETY ENGINEERING> is <ENGINEERING> that assures that engineered systems provide acceptable levels of safety

A <SAFETY ENGINEERING DESIGN STRATEGY DOCUMENT> is an <ENGINEERING DESIGN STRATEGY DOCUMENT> that covers safety design in order to meet regulatory requirements and to conform to the applicable codes and standards
A <SAFETY ENGINEERING DISCIPLINE> is a <DISCIPLINE> that is capable of <SAFETY ENGINEERING>

A <SEAL FLUSHING SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SEAL SYSTEM> intended to deliver sealing fluid to seals in order to provide a liquid film between the seal faces and to remove friction heat
A <SEAL GAS CONDENSATE OUTLET> is a <FLUID OUTLET PORT> intended to drain seal gas
A <SEAL GAS INLET> is a <FLUID INLET PORT> intended for the supply of seal gas

A <SEAL GAS SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SEAL SYSTEM> intended to deliver pressurized sealing gas in order to ensure a proper operation of dry gas seals including control of leakage to flare and / or vent
A <SEAL GAS VENT> is a <VENT PORT> intended to vent seal gas
A <SEAL GLAND ASSEMBLY> is an <EQUIPMENT COMPONENT> that consists of gland, bolting and non-rotating portion of a seal

A <SEAL JACKET> is a <JACKET> that can be either part of the seal gland assembly or the pump casing off the seal in order to control the temperature of the seal and hence proper functioning of the seal.

A <SEAL KIT> is a <MACHINE COMPONENT> that is a collection of gaskets and/or lip seals, sealing rings and related components, and been found essential or useful to be collected in a spare part package for a certain machine or unit
<SEAL LEAKAGE DETECTING> is <DETECTING> whether a seal is leaking
A <SEAL OIL INLET> is a <FLUID INLET PORT> intended for the supply of seal oil
A <SEAL OIL OUTLET > is a <FLUID OUTLET PORT> intended to drain seal oil
A <SEAL OIL SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SEAL SYSTEM> and an <OIL SYSTEM> that provides seal oil to seals of equipment involved
A <SEAL ORIFICE> is a <RESTRICTION ORIFICE> intended to limit the flow of seal flush to the seal
A <SEAL O-RING> is an <O-RING> used to create leak free joints between mechanical seal components, the shaft and casing.
A <SEAL PAN> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <BLOCKER> intended to prevent passage of vapour through a downcomer and that has a shape of a pan
A <SEAL PIPING SYSTEM> is a <PIPING SYSTEM> intended to be used to transport sealing fluid.
A <SEAL RING> is a <RING> and a <SEAL> to create leak free joints between equipment component parts
subclasses: ORIFICE PLATE SEAL, O-RING, PIPE HUB END SEAL RING, PRIMARY RING, U-RING, V-RING

description: A <SEAL SLIPS> is a <SLIPS> that are equipped with seals.
A <SEAL SPRING> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SPRING> that is located between collar and compression ring and used to push seal faces together in order to have a constant pressure on the rotating seal ring
A <SEAL SPRING HOLDER> is a <RING> that is located between the rotating face and the seal spring and serves as spring retainer ring

A <SEAL SUPPORT SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SYSTEM> that is designed to keep high process security and are developed to seal products within their emission limits. ... Main task of a seal support system is the cooling effect and a controlled lubrication of the mechanical seal faces
A <SEAL SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and an <AUXILIARY SYSTEM> that that is the configuration of hardware components in order to have seals flushed with pressurized fluid
subclasses: CENTRIFUGAL COMPRESSOR SEAL SYSTEM, COMPRESSOR SEAL SYSTEM, EXPANDER SEAL SYSTEM, PUMP SEAL SYSTEM, SEAL FLUSHING SYSTEM, SEAL GAS SYSTEM, SEAL OIL SYSTEM

description: A <SEAL WEDGE> is a <DYNAMIC SEAL> conically shaped rotating seal ring.
A <SEALED BEAM LAMP> is a <PRESSED GLASS LAMP> in which light source, reflector, and lens form a sealed, self-contained unit.

A <SEALED BEARING> is an<ARTEFACT> and a <BEARING> that  has a seal around the moving parts, which is usually made from rubber or metal. It is self-enclosed; not only does the seal lock out debris, but it also keeps lubrication trapped inside
A <SEALED CONNECTOR> is an <ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR> employing a seal capable of fulfilling specified gas-tightness requirements

A <SEALED MACHINE> is an <ELECTRIC ROTATING MACHINE> provided with special seals to minimise the leakage of the internal coolant out of the enclosure, or of the surrounding medium into the machine, during normal operation
A <SEALED ONE PIECE BALL VALVE> is an <ONE PIECE BALL VALVE> that has a single piece body in a welded construction
A <SEALED PRIMARY BATTERY> is an <ELECTRIC BATTERY> that remains closed and does not release either gas or liquid when operated within the limits specified by the manufacturer
A <SEALED REACTOR> is an <ELECTRICAL REACTOR> that is non-breathing, that is, so sealed that there can be no significant interchange between its contents and the external atmosphere
A <SEALED TRANSFORMER> is an <OIL IMMERSED TYPE TRANSFORMER> that is non-breathing, that is, so sealed that there can be no significant interchange between its contents and the external atmosphere
A <SEALER> is an <INDIVIDUAL IN A ROLE> of being or having been <SEALING> something
A <SEALING END> is a <CABLE TERMINATOR> providing a seal to the end of the cable from the external environment and maintaining the pressure, if any, of the cable system
A <SEALING MATERIAL> is a <FLUID COMPOUND> that is intended to form a tight barrier for moving fluids between two spaces
subclasses: DRILLING FLUID

description: <SEALING OFF> is the <Activity> of closing tightly so as to eliminate ingress or egress
subclasses: HEAT-SEALING

description: A <SEALING STEAM CONTROL VALVE> is an <INSTRUMENTATION ITEM> and a <CONTROL VALVE> that reduces the steam supply pressure from the admission steam valve to a very slight overpressure to avoid air inrush into the shaft labyrinths of a condensing steam turbine

A <SEALING STRIP> is a <STRIP> intended to minimize leakage and typically applied in steam turbines preventing steam leakage to pass a steam turbine blade tip into the following nozzle and mounted between blade shrouds and casing diaphragms.
A <SEALING STRIP LABYRINTH SEAL> is a <LABYRINTH SEAL> that has stripes fixed to the shaft with <CAULKING WIRE>
A <SEALLESS CENTRIFUGAL PUMP> is a <CENTRIFUGAL PUMP> that does not contain conventional seals but prevent leakage of the pumped liquid to the atmosphere by other means
subclasses: CANNED MOTOR CENTRIFUGAL PUMP, MAGNETIC DRIVE CENTRIFUGAL PUMP, MAGNETICALLY COUPLED PUMP

description: A <SEAL-OFF PRESSURE> is a <PRESSURE> at which a valve is fully closed and there is no further fluid at the downstream side of the seat
<SEAMLESS> is an <INDIVIDUAL WITH A STATUS> that has been fabricated without a welded seam
subclasses: SEAMLESS ARTEFACT

description: A <SEAMLESS ARTEFACT> is a <WROUGHT ARTEFACT> with a <SEAMLESS> Status with no welding seams
subclasses: SEAMLESS PIPE

description: A <SEAMLESS PIPE> is a <SEAMLESS ARTEFACT> and a <PIPE>  that is manufactured without longitudinal or spiral shaped welds
subclasses: DRILL PIPE, DRILL PIPE BODY

description: <SEARCHING> is the <Activity> of acting by looking into or over carefully and thoroughly in an effort to find something
A <SEARCHLIGHT> is a <PROJECTOR> suspended in a frame so that it may throw a beam of light in any desired direction.
A <SEAT GASKET> is an <O-RING> that seals the stationary face vs. the seal end plate.
A <SEAT SEAL> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SEAL> intended to prevent the leakage of fluids/gas through a valve
A <SEATING> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SUPPORT> that is serving as the base of something else
A <SEATING SURFACE> is a <SURFACE> that is for the support of something else.
<SEAWATER> is a <WATER> that is salt water from the sea. It is a solution of water (H2O) and sodium (NaCl) that also can contain other contaminants
A <SEAWATER COOLER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <COOLER> and a <FLUID CONTAINER> that uses sea water as cooling medium
A <SEAWATER COOLING SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <COOLING SYSTEM> that uses sea water as the cooling medium

A <SEAWATER HIGH PRESSURE SUPPLY SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SEAWATER SUPPLY SYSTEM> that includes services for filtering/deaeration, pumping, the manifold and the water injection system. The header and distribution of jet water are also included
A <SEAWATER LIFT PUMP> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <LIFT PUMP> that can be used for seawater
A <SEAWATER LOW PRESSURE SUPPLY SYSTEM> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SEAWATER SUPPLY SYSTEM> that includes services for lifting, filtration, pumping and distribution of sea water
A <SEAWATER SUPPLY SYSTEM> is a <WATER SYSTEM> that supplies sea water
subclasses: SEAWATER HIGH PRESSURE SUPPLY SYSTEM, SEAWATER LOW PRESSURE SUPPLY SYSTEM

description: A <SEAWATER SURFACE> is a <WATER SURFACE> of sea water.
A <SECOND DECK> is  a <DECK> that is below the main deck
A <SECOND END CONNECTION> is a <CONNECTION POINT> that is, in the Oil and Gas domain, made at the enf of the installation process
A <SECOND IN SEQUENCE> is an <ArrangementOfIndividual> that indicates that the 'part' is the second in the sequence represented by the 'whole'
The <SECOND LATERAL CRITICAL SPEED> is the second <SPEED> of rotation at which excessive <DISPLACEMENT> may be induced in a system
The <SECOND LATERAL CRITICAL SPEED DAMPED> is the  second <SPEED> of rotation at which excessive <DISPLACEMENT> may be induced  in a damped system
The <SECOND LATERAL CRITICAL SPEED UNDAMPED> is the fourth <SPEED> of rotation at which excessive  displacement may be induced in an undamped system

A <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA> is a <Property> that is the second axial moment of area of a plane area (section) about an axis in its plane is the sum (integral) of the products of its elements of area and the squares of their distance from the axis. (I =Integral(r*r)dA, where r is the distance normal from the axis to the area element dA.)
subclasses: SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT ETA-AXIS, SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT KSI-AXIS, SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT U AXIS, SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT V AXIS, SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT X AXIS, SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT Y AXIS

description: A <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT ETA-AXIS> is a <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA> (axial) of a plane area (section) about an axis (eta). I eta=Integral(r*r)dA

uniqueName: SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT KSI-AXIS
description: A <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT KSI-AXIS> is a <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA> (axial) of a plane area (section) about an axis (ksi). I ksi=Integral(r*r)dA

uniqueName: SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT U AXIS
description: A <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT U AXIS> is a <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA> (axial) of a plane area (section) about an axis (u). Iu=Integral(r*r)dA

uniqueName: SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT V AXIS
description: A <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT V AXIS> is a <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA> (axial) of a plane area (section) about an axis (v). Iv=Integral(r*r)dA

uniqueName: SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT X AXIS
description: A <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT X AXIS> is a <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA> (axial) of a plane area (section) about an axis (x). Ix=Integral(r*r)dA

uniqueName: SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT Y AXIS
description: A <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA ABOUT Y AXIS> is a <SECOND MOMENT OF AREA> (axial) of a plane area (section) about an axis (y). Iy=Integral(r*r)dA

A <SECOND POLAR MOMENT OF AREA> is a <Property> that is a second polar moment of area of a plane area (section) about a point in its plane is the sim (integral) of the products of its elements of area and the squares of their distances from the point

A <SECOND RADIATION CONSTANT> is a <Property> that is the constant c1 and c2 in the expression for the spectral concentration of the radiant exitance of a full radiator (black body) at the thermodynamic temperature T M = c1.f(lambda,T) = c1.lambda^5/(e^(c2/(lambda.T))-1)
A <SECOND STAGE SEPARATOR> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SEPARATOR> that is the second one in a process to separate material (typically solid particles) from a stream
The <SECOND TORSIONAL CRITICAL SPEED> is a the second <SPEED> of rotation at which excessive twisting may be induced in a system
A <SECOND(angle)> is a <PropertyQuantification>
A <SECOND(time)> is a <PropertyQuantification> between a <TIME> and a <NUMBER SPACE OF 0 TO INF>
A <SECONDARY BATTERY> is an <ELECTRIC BATTERY> that comprises two or more <SECONDARY CELL>s, electrically connected and used as a source of energy
subclasses: ALKALINE SECONDARY BATTERY

description: A <SECONDARY CELL> is an <ELECTRIC BATTERY CELL> that is designed to be electrically recharged

uniqueName: SECONDARY CONTROLLING OF ACTIVE POWER IN A SYSTEM
description: <SECONDARY CONTROLLING OF ACTIVE POWER IN A SYSTEM> is <POWER SYSTEM CONTROLLING> of the active power supplied to the network by particular generators
<SECONDARY FAILURE> is <FAILING> of an item caused either directly or indirectly by the failure of another item
A <SECONDARY NOMINAL DIAMETER> is a <NOMINAL DIAMETER> that is the second largest nominal diameter of a <PhysicalObject>
A <SECONDARY RELAY> is an <ELECTRICAL RELAY> that is energized by the current or voltage derived from an instrument transformer or a transducer
A <SECONDARY SIZE> is an <IndirectProperty> that is a <NOMINAL SIZE> typically is for vents and drains in the context of a PIPING LINE LIST
A <SECTION> is an <ARTEFACT> that is one of the distinct parts that something is physically or logically divided into and which together constitute a whole
subclasses: COLUMN SECTION, DEAD LEG, PIPELINE SECTION

subclasses: SECTION MODULUS REF ETA AXIS, SECTION MODULUS REF U AXIS, SECTION MODULUS REF V AXIS, SECTION MODULUS REF X AXIS, SECTION MODULUS REF Y AXIS

description: A <SECTION MODULUS REF ETA AXIS> is a <SECTION MODULUS> that is a section modulus with respect to an axis (eta) in the plane is W= Ieta/r, where Ieta is second moment of area/ inertia to the furthest point on the surface

A <SECTION MODULUS REF U AXIS> is a <SECTION MODULUS> that is a section modulus with respect to an axis (u) in the plane is W= Iu/r, where Ix is second moment of area/ inertia to the farest point on the surface

A <SECTION MODULUS REF V AXIS> is a <SECTION MODULUS> that is a section modulus with respect to an axis (v) in the plane is W= Iv/r, where Ix is second moment of area/ inertia to the farest point on the surface

A <SECTION MODULUS REF X AXIS> is a <SECTION MODULUS> that is a section modulus with respect to an axis (x) in the plane is W= Ix/r, where Ix is second moment of area/ inertia to the farest point on the surface

A <SECTION MODULUS REF Y AXIS> is a <SECTION MODULUS> that is a section modulus with respect to an axis (y) in the plane is W= Iy/r, where Iy is second moment of area/ inertia to the farest point on the surface
An <SECTIONAL PLATE> is a <PLATE> that is composed from several plate sections
An <SECTIONAL TRAY> is a <TRAY> that is composed from several tray sections.
An <SECTOR-SHAPED CONDUCTOR> is a <SHAPED CONDUCTOR> the cross-section of which approximates to a sector of a circle
<SECURING> is the <Activity> of acting by relieving from exposure to danger
An <SECURITY RATED DOOR ASSEMBLY> is a <DOOR ASSEMBLY> that is capable of providing protection against forced entry as defined for the rated conditions under which the type of door has been approved
An <SECURITY RATED DOOR FRAME> is a <DOOR FRAME> that is capable of providing protection against forced entry as defined for the rated conditions under which the type of door has been approved.
An <SECURITY RATED DOOR SET> is a <DOOR SET> which is capable of providing protection against forced entry as defined for the rated conditions under which the type of door has been approved
A <SECURITY SERVICE> is a <SERVICE> of warranting the security of goods
A <SECURITY SERVICE DISCIPLINE> is a <DISCIPLINE> that is capable of <SECURITY SERVICE>
subclasses: SECURITY SERVICE TEAM

description: A <SECURITY SERVICE TEAM> is a <TEAM> in a <SECURITY SERVICE DISCIPLINE>
A <SEDIMENT PUMP> is  a <PUMP> that is specifically designed for <PUMPING> <SEDIMENT>
<SEDIMENTARY ROCK> is <ROCK> that is formed by the deposition of sediment
subclasses: LIMESTONE

description: <SEDIMENTING> is the <Activity> of settling by forming or depositing sediment

The <SEEBECK COEFFICIENT> is a <Property> of a material that is a measure of the magnitude of an induced thermoelectric voltage in response to a temperature difference across that material, as induced by the Seebeck effectSab = dEab/dT where T is the temperature of the hot junction
<SEEKING> is the <Activity> of trying to find or get something
A <SEGMENT> is a <COMPONENT> that is each of several parts into which a thing is or can be divided or marked off
subclasses: PIPING NETWORK SEGMENT, PROCESS SEGMENT, STREAM SEGMENT

description: A <SEGMENTAL BAFFLE> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <BAFFLE> that is mounted inside the shell in a shell and tube heat exchanger to force the shell-side flow across or alongside the tubes for a better performance
types: ClassOfInanimatePhysicalObject, HEATERS, COOLERS AND HEAT TRANSFER

description: A <SEGMENTAL DOWNCOMER> is a <DOWNCOMER> that is composed from several downcomer segments
A <SEGMENTAL ORIFICE HOLE> is a <HOLE> where the wall surface, i.e. the boundary between the solid and the no-solid, has the form of a circle segment.
A <SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE> is a <VOLUME FLOW MEASURING ELEMENT - ORIFICE PLATE> with an orifice that has the form of a segment of a circle
superclasses: VOLUME FLOW MEASURING ELEMENT - ORIFICE PLATE
subclasses: SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE FOR DIRTY GAS, SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE FOR DIRTY LIQUID

uniqueName: SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE FOR DIRTY GAS
description: A <SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE FOR DIRTY GAS> is a <SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE> that is in the form of a segment of a circle, the cord of which is vertical. The hole is tangential to the side of the conduit

uniqueName: SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE FOR DIRTY LIQUID
description: A <SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE FOR DIRTY LIQUID> is a <SEGMENTAL ORIFICE PLATE> that is in the form of a segment of a circle, the cord of which is horizontal. The hole is tangential to the bottom of the conduit
A <SEGMENTED BALL CONTROL VALVE> is a <BALL CONTROL VALVE> with rotary motion with a closure member that is a segment of a sphere
A <SEGMENTED FLANGE> is a <PIPE FLANGE> where a part of the rim (a segment) has been removed to make room such that flanges can be located closer together
subclasses: SEGMENTED FLANGE RING JOINT

description: A <SEGMENTED FLANGE RING JOINT> is a <RING JOINT FLANGE> and a <SEGMENTED FLANGE>
<SEGMENT-TO-SEGMENT TESTING> is <ELECTRICAL ROTATING MACHINE TESTING> in which the resistance between adjacent commutator segments is measured in order to check that the winding is satisfactory
<SEGREGATING> is the <Activity> of separating or setting apart from others or from the general mass
A <SEGREGATION SEPARATOR> is a <GRAVITY SEPARATOR> for separating a process flow into separate phases - utilizing a type of segregation process.
subclasses: SEGREGATION SEPARATOR WITH AUTOMATIC DRAIN, SEGREGATION SEPARATOR WITH MANUAL DRAIN, SEGREGATION SEPARATOR WITH PRECHAMBER

description: A <SEGREGATION SEPARATOR WITH AUTOMATIC DRAIN> is a <SEGREGATION SEPARATOR> designed with automatic drain, e.g. by use of a floater valve or a valve controled by a liquid level measuring instrument.
A <SEGREGATION SEPARATOR WITH MANUAL DRAIN> is a <SEGREGATION SEPARATOR> designed with manual drain, i.e. the drain valve has to be operated manually.
A <SEGREGATION SEPARATOR WITH PRECHAMBER> is a <SEGREGATION SEPARATOR> designed with prechamber for separating e.g. water from a fluid.
A <SEISMIC LOAD> is a <DYNAMIC LOAD> caused by seismic activity
A <SEISMIC PROBE> is a <PROBE> for detecting shock waves set off by an explosion or other seismic sources and reflected by underground rock formations
An <SEK> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Swedish Krona' and used in SWEDEN

A <SELECTED FLOW COEFFICIENT> is a <FLOW COEFFICIENT> that is the selected (eg. wanted) flow of water that can be passed by the object when a <PRESSURE> drop of 1 bar (actually 0,981bar) act across it
<SELECTING> is the <Activity> of acting by choosing from a number or group by a distinguishing feature
subclasses: MATERIALS SELECTING

description: <SELECTIVE LEACHING> is <CORROSION> where only one element in a metallic alloy is removed
A <SELECTOR SWITCH> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <SWITCHING DEVICE> that has more then two possible positoning states
subclasses: AUTOMATIC SELECTOR SWITCH, MANUAL SELECTOR SWITCH

description: A <SELENIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Se and atomic number 34. It is a nonmetal

A <SELF INDUCTANCE> is a <Property> that is the induction of a voltage in a current-carrying wire when the current in the wire itself is changing. In the case of self-inductance, the magnetic field created by a changing current in the circuit itself induces a voltage in the same circuit. It is calculated as:  L = Psi / I where I is an electric <CURRENT> in a thin conducting loop and Psi is the linked flux caused by that electric current

An object is a <SELF INTERSECTING CURVE> if and only if: it is a <CURVE>; it contains at least one point such that the part of the curve in the neighbourhood of the point, taken in isolation, is not a 1 dimensional manifold_projection
An object is a <SELF INTERSECTING SOLID> if and only if: it is a <SOLID>; it is not a <NON SELF INTERSECTING SOLID>
A <SELF INTERSECTING SURFACE> is a <GEOMETRY SURFACE> if and only if: it is a <GEOMETRY SURFACE> ; it is not a <NON SELF INTERECTING SURFACE>
A <SELF LUBRICATED GEAR COUPLING> is a gear coupling that is self lubricated.
A <SELF PRIMING CENTRIFUGAL PUMP> is a <CENTRIFUGAL PUMP> that is designed have the ability to prime itself automatically, after being initially filled and operating under a suction lift.

A <SELF-ALIGNING BALL BEARING> is a <BALL BEARING> that has two rows of balls with two separate raceways in the inner ring and a common sphered raceway in the outer ring, permitting angular misalignment of the shaft relative to the housing.
<SELF-CHECKING> is <CHECKING(verifying)>(verifying) automatically without an external trigger
A <SELF-CHECKING DEVICE> is a <FunctionalObject> that has the capability of <CHECKING> whether it is operating within specifications

A <SELF-CONTAINED BREATHING APPARATUS> is a <BREATHING APPARATUS> that provides breathable air in an IDLH (Immediate Danger to Life and Health) atmosphere, and that is not dependent on a remote supply (e.g. through a long hose).
A <SELF-CONTAINED PRESSURE CABLE> is a <PRESSURE CABLE> in which the pressurizing fluid is contained within the metallic sheath applied during manufacture.
subclasses: OIL-FILLED CABLE

description: A <SELF-COOLED MACHINE> is an <ELECTRIC ROTATING MACHINE> where the cooling is obtained by means of its own rotation
A <SELF-HEALING CAPACITOR> is a <CAPACITOR> of which the electrical properties after local breakdown of the dielectric, are rapidly and essentially restored
A <SELF-LEVELING PLATE> is a <LEVELING PLATE> that is self-leveling

A <SELF-OPERATING VALVE> is an <INSTRUMENTATION FUNCTION> and a <VALVE> that includes a means of operation (e.g. spring / gravity / fluid pressure / counter balance), and is not depending on an external source of energy
subclasses: FLOW REGULATOR, LEVEL REGULATOR, OVERPRESSURE PROTECTION VALVE, PRESSURE REGULATOR, PRESSURE RELIEF DEVICE, TEMPERATURE REGULATOR, THERMAL RELIEF DEVICE, VACUUM RELIEF DEVICE

description: <SELF-PRIMING> is the <Activity> of priming without external energy or tools
A <SELF-REGULATING TRACE HEATING CABLE> is a <TRACE HEATING CABLE> in which the thermal output generated at its operating voltage decreases as the temperature of its environment increases.
<SELF-SYNCHRONISATION> is <SYNCHRONISING> an unloaded and unexcited synchronous machine that is excited either at the same time as it is coupled to the system or shortly afterwards
A <SELF-TAPPING THREADED FASTENER>is an <ARTEFACT> and a <THREADED FASTENER> that is furnished with threads that cuts or forms its own internal threads when driven in
subclasses: THREAD CUTTING THREADED FASTENER, THREAD FORMING THREADED FASTENER

description: <SELLING> is the <Activity> of acting by disposing of something by sale

A <SEMI SUBMERSIBLE STRUCTURE> is a <FLOATING STRUCTURE> that is a facility that is a seabed-anchored or dynamically positioned buoyant/compliant substructure which provides support for topside structure and equipment.
A <SEMICAST CYLINDER COLUMN> is a <CYLINDER COLUMN> (cylinder block) that is partly made of cast iron and partly of welded steel.
A <SEMICAST ENGINE BED PLATE> is a <PISTON ENGINE BED PLATE> that is partly made of cast iron and partly of welded steel.

subclasses: COMBINATOR, COMPARATOR, PHOTODIODE, SEMICONDUCTOR DIODE, THYRISTOR, TRANSISTOR

description: A <SEMICONDUCTOR CONVERTER> is an <ELECTRONIC CONVERTER> with semiconductor valve devices

subclasses: FREQUENCY-MULTIPLICATION DIODE, MIXER DIODE, SEMICONDUCTOR RECTIFIER DIODE, SWITCHING DIODE, TUNNEL DIODE, VARIABLE-CAPACITANCE DIODE, VOLTAGE-REFERENCE DIODE, VOLTAGE-REGULATOR DIODE, ZENER DIODE

description: A <SEMICONDUCTOR RECTIFIER DIODE> is a <SEMICONDUCTOR DIODE> designed for rectification and including its associated mounting and cooling attachments if integral with it.

subclasses: ELECTRONIC AC POWER SWITCH, ELECTRONIC DC POWER SWITCH

<SEMI-FINISHED> is an <INDIVIDUAL WITH A STATUS> in a state of not been completely assembled or manufactured and generally exported from the country of origin to be completed in the country where the product is being sold
subclasses: SEMI-FINISHED GOODS
