description: A <Y COORDINATE RELATIVE TO LOCAL DATUM POINT> is a <STRAIGHT LINEAR DISTANCE> that is the y coordinate of a <PhysicalObject> from a given <DATUM POINT>
A <Y STRAINER> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <STRAINER> that is Y-shaped
A <YAGI ANTENNA> is an <ANTENNA> that is normally made up by one dipole, as a reflector element and several directors, all mounted on a boom
A <YARD> is a <PropertyQuantification> between a <LENGTH> and a <NUMBER SPACE OF 0 TO INF>
A <YARD(site)> is an <AREA(space)> that is set apart for the growing, rearing, breeding, or storing of something or the carrying on of some work or business

A <Y-BEARING UNIT> is a <RADIAL/THRUST BALL BEARING> that is a simple economic ball bearing unit consisting of a deep groove ball bearing and a bearing housing made of cast iron or pressed steel having a sphered bore enabling the unit to allow moderate errors of alignment.
A <YEAR AVERAGE DENSITY> is an <IndirectProperty> that refers to a <DENSITY> that is the average of all measured densities during a <DURATION> of one year
A <YEAR PERIOD> is a <PeriodInTime> that is all space of time within a given year starting at 00:00 January 1'st and ending at 24:00 December 31'st
A <YEAR TO DATE PERIOD> is a <PeriodInTime> that is all time within a period starting at the beginning of a calendar year and ending at a given date
subclasses: YEAR TO MONTHLY PRODUCTION REPORT END DATE

uniqueName: YEAR TO MONTHLY PRODUCTION REPORT END DATE
description: A <YEAR TO MONTHLY PRODUCTION REPORT END DATE> is an <YEAR TO DATE PERIOD> that is a period of time consisting of the interval from the beginning of a calendar year (GMT+1) to a Monhtly Production Report end time within that year
A <YEARLY AVERAGE TEMPERATURE ENVIRONMENT> is an <AMBIENT TEMPERATURE CLASSIFIED ENVIRONMENT> that has a given yearly average temperature
<YEAST> is a <BiologicalMatter> that is an eukaryotic, single-celled microorganism classified as a member of the fungus kingdom.

<YELLOW>  is a <VISIBLE COLOUR> with a <WAVELENGTH> of 565-590 nm, with 580 nm for pure yellow; It is a primary color in the subtractive color system (CMY) and is formed by mixing red and green light in the additive color system
A <YER> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Yemeni Rial' and used in YEMEN
A <Y-GLOBE VALVE> is a <GLOBE VALVE> and a <Y-PATTERN VALVE> that has in-line ports and stem emerging at about 45 degrees to the centerline, hence the name Y

A <YIELD POINT> is a <STRESS> at which a substantial amount of plastic deformation takes place under constant or reduced load. This sudden yielding is a characteristic of iron and annealed steels. In other metals, plastic deformation begins gradually and its incidence is indicated by measuring the proof stress, which, however, is frequently called the yield point
A <YIELD STRENGTH> is a <STRESS> that is the highest a material can take and still be elastic. Increasing stress will cause the material to be plastic

A <YIELD STRESS> is a <STRESS> that marks the transition from elastic to plastic behaviour and is the minimum stress at which a solid will undergo permanent deformation or plastic flow without a significant increase in the load or external force
A <YIELD STRESS SPECIFICATION> is a <SPECIFICATION> that is specifying yield stress
A <YIELD STRESS SPECIFICATION DEFINITION> is a <SPECIFICATION DEFINITION> that defines the rules for the contents of a specification of yield stress
A <YOKE> is an <ARTEFACT> that is an arched device intended to embrace two parts to hold or unite them in position, or to divide loads
subclasses: BRUSH YOKE, ELECTROMAGNET YOKE, RELAY YOKE, TRANSFORMER YOKE

description: A <YOKE BUSH> is a <BUSHING> that is screwed, and is retained in a yoke to which a hand wheel or actuator is connected. Rotation of the bush is intended to cause a valve stem to move up or down.
A <YOKE PLATE> is a <PLATE> that is joining and carrying piles
subclasses: LOWER YOKE PLATE, UPPER YOKE PLATE

description: A <YOKE SLEEVE> is an <SLEEVE>, normally with internal threads, enclosing the valve stem and when turned by the hand wheel, causing the valve to close or open
A <YOKE-TYPE VALVE BONNET> is a <VALVE BONNET> that is in the form of a yoke.
subclasses: VALVE BONNET OUTSIDE SCREW AND YOKE

description: <YOUNGS MODULUS OF ELASTICITY> is a <Property> that is a measure of the ability of a material to withstand changes in length when under lengthwise tension or compression. It is equal to the longitudinal stress divided by the strain
A <Y-PATTERN GLOBE VALVE BODY> is a <GLOBE VALVE BODY> and a <Y-PATTERN VALVE BODY>
superclasses: GLOBE VALVE BODY, Y-PATTERN VALVE BODY

description: A <Y-PATTERN VALVE> is an <ARTEFACT> and a <VALVE> that has in-line ports and stem emerging at an angle of approx 45 degrees
subclasses: OBLIQUE PATTERN VALVE, WYE-BODY VALVE, Y-GLOBE VALVE

description: A <Y-PATTERN VALVE BODY> is a <VALVE BODY> of a Y-pattern valve
subclasses: Y-PATTERN GLOBE VALVE BODY

description: A <Y-SWING CHECK VALVE BODY> is a <SWING CHECK VALVE BODY> that is designed for a Y-swing check valve.
A <YTTERBIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Yb and atomic number 70. It is an element in the lanthanide series
A <YTTRIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Y and atomic number 39. It is a transition metal
<YYYY-MM-DD> is a <DATE REPRESENTATION> of the example format 2004-12-27
<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM> is a <DATE REPRESENTATION> of the example format 2006-06-15T14:15

description: A <Z COORDINATE FOR CENTRE OF GRAVITY RELATIVE TO LOCAL DATUM POINT> is a <STRAIGHT LINEAR DISTANCE> that is a cartesian z coordinate of a <CENTRE OF GRAVITY> from a given <DATUM POINT>

uniqueName: Z COORDINATE RELATIVE TO LOCAL DATUM POINT
description: A <Z COORDINATE RELATIVE TO LOCAL DATUM POINT> is a <STRAIGHT LINEAR DISTANCE> that is the z coordinate of a <PhysicalObject> from a given <DATUM POINT>
A <Z PROFILE> is a <SOLID PROFILE> having a Z shaped crossection.

A <ZANKER CONDITIONER> is a <FLOW STRAIGHTENER> consisting of a perforated plate with holes of certain specified sizes followed by a number of channels (one for each hole) formed by the intersection of a number of plates.
A <ZAR> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Rand' and used in SOUTH AFRICA, LESOTHO, and NAMIBIA
A <ZENER BARRIER> is an <INTRINSICALLY SAFE BARRIER> that is a circuit consisting of a zener diode(s) that is acting like a short circuit limiting the voltage into a system.
A <ZENER DIODE> is a <SEMICONDUCTOR DIODE> with a characteristic showing a sharp increase in reverse current at a certain critical voltage.
A <ZERO ADJUSTER> is a <FunctionalObject> that has the capability of <ADJUSTING> the zero position of a <MEASURING INSTRUMENT>
A <ZERO ELEVATION> is, for an elevated zero range, a <Property> that is a measure of how much the zero of the measured variable is above the actual lower measuring range value
A <ZERO INSERTION FORCE COMPONENT> is an <ARTEFACT> designed to eliminate the insertion and withdrawal forces during mating and unmating
<ZERO POWER-FACTOR TESTING> is <ELECTRICAL ROTATING MACHINE TESTING> that is no-load testing in which a synchronous machine is over-excited and operated at a power-factor very close to zero
A <ZERO SEQUENCE CURRENT COMPONENT> is an unbalanced <ELECTRIC CURRENT> in a circuit during an earth fault; also called the DC component of the fault current
A <ZERO SEQUENCE VOLTAGE COMPONENT> is an unbalanced <VOLTAGE in a circuit during an earth fault
A <ZERO SUPPRESSION> is, for a suppressed-zero range, a <Property> that is a measure of how much the zero of the measured variable is below the actual lower measuring range value
<ZERO TO MANY> is a <Class> that is an instance of <Cardinality> that has a minimum number of zero and a maximum number of many
<ZERO TO ONE> is a <Class> that is an instance of <Cardinality> that has a minimum number of zero and a maximum number of many
A <ZEROL GEAR> is a <GEAR> that has curved teeth.
A <ZEROL GEARBOX> is a <CROSSED AXIS GEARBOX> that has an input and output shaft that forms an angle to each other, typically of 90> degree, and contains a pinion and gear with curved gear teeth.

A <ZIGZAG CONNECTED WINDING> is a <TRANSFORMER WINDING> in which one end of each phase winding of a polyphase transformer or reactor is connected to a common point, i.e. the neutral point, and each phase winding consists of two parts in which phase-displaced voltages are induced
A <ZINC> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Zn and atomic number 30. It is a transition metal, alternatively considered a post-transition metal
A <ZINC ALLOY> is a <METAL ALLOY> in which Zinc is the basis (i.e. predominant) element
A <ZINC CHLORIDE BATTERY> is an <ELECTRIC BATTERY> with a saline electrolyte based on zinc chloride, a positive electrode containing manganese dioxide and a negative electrode of zinc
A <ZINC COMPOUND> is a <METALLIC COMPOUND> where the predominant element is zinc (Zn)
A <ZINC SILVER OXIDE BATTERY> is an <ALKALINE PRIMARY BATTERY> with an alkaline electrolyte, a positive electrode containing silver oxide and a negative electrode of zinc.

A <ZINC-CARBON BATTERY> is an <DRY CELL BATTERY> and a <PRIMARY BATTERY> that provides direct electric current from the electrochemical reaction between zinc and manganese dioxide. It produces a voltage of about 1.5 volts between the zinc anode, which is typically realized as a container for the battery, and a carbon rod of positive polarity, the cathode, that collects the current from the manganese dioxide electrode
A <ZIRCONIUM> is an <Atom> and a <CHEMICAL ELEMENT> with symbol Zr and atomic number 40. It is a transition metal
A <ZMW> is a <CURRENCY> called 'Zambian Kwacha' and used in ZAMBIA
A <ZOELLY-RATEAU TURBINE> is an <IMPULSE STEAM TURBINE> that is provided with more than one pressure stage, each followed by a velocity stage
A <ZWL> is a <CURRENCY> called &amp;#39;Zimbabwe Dollar&amp;#39; and used in ZIMBABWE
A <False> is a <Relationship> that denotes that the classified Relationship is asserted to be false
A <True> is a <Relationship> that denotes that the classified Relationship is asserted to be true
